description: Lipo Lab (PPC Solution) is a professional-use injectable lipolysis solution manufactured in South Korea by Medihub Laboratories, formulated for localized subcutaneous fat reduction and body contouring. It pairs high-purity phosphatidylcholine with sodium deoxycholate plus L-carnitine and sodium hyaluronate. It is positioned as a non-surgical mesotherapy option for stubborn, diet- and exercise-resistant fat pockets.
howItWorks: Sodium deoxycholate acts as a detergent that, together with phosphatidylcholine (PPC), disrupts adipocyte cell membranes and triggers adipocytolysis. The liberated lipids and cellular debris are then cleared through the lymphatic system and metabolized over several weeks, with L-carnitine supporting fatty-acid transport. An inflammatory response drives the expected swelling over the first 3-7 days.
composition: Phosphatidylcholine (PPC) with sodium deoxycholate; adjuncts L-carnitine and sodium hyaluronate
usageNotes: Inject subcutaneously into the mid-fat plane using a fanning or grid pattern (27-30G), keeping per-point volumes conservative (approx. 0.15-0.2 mL). Stage sessions roughly 2-4 weeks apart and anticipate swelling, tenderness and bruising for 3-7 days. Avoid superficial dermal or intramuscular placement, and map regional anatomy before treating.
features: Dual-lipolytic PPC plus sodium deoxycholate formula
benefits: Non-surgical alternative to liposuction for localized fat
Well-recognized brand that supports patient confidence
Predictable staged protocol suits package/course pricing
Broad body-area applicability for varied case mix

description: Lipo Lab V-Line is the facial-slimming variant of the Lipo Lab range from Medihub Laboratories, developed for the delicate jawline, jowl and submental region. It combines a botanical lipolytic blend with phosphatidylcholine/deoxycholate-class action plus L-carnitine and sodium hyaluronate to support skin elasticity during fat reduction. It is intended for lower-volume, precision facial contouring.
howItWorks: The formulation disrupts adipocyte membranes in the facial fat pad, and the released lipids clear gradually via the lymphatic system over weeks. Botanical extracts and L-carnitine are included to support metabolism and skin tone during the process. Because facial volumes are small, swelling over the first 3-7 days is typically more contained than with body treatments.
composition: Phosphatidylcholine / sodium deoxycholate with a botanical blend (Aesculus hippocastanum / horse chestnut, Juglans regia, Fumaria officinalis), plus L-carnitine, tyrosine, thiamine and sodium hyaluronate
usageNotes: Inject into the facial subcutaneous mid-fat plane in small, conservative volumes (up to roughly 1 vial / 5 mL per facial session) with a 30G needle, staging sessions 3-4 weeks apart. Knowledge of the marginal mandibular nerve course along the jawline is essential; avoid deep or near-mandibular injection. Expect swelling for 3-7 days.

description: Slim Point Body is an enzyme-based body lipolysis solution by the South Korean manufacturer Maypharm Co., Ltd., which uses bromelain and lecithin rather than a deoxycholic-acid detergent. It is designed for localized body-fat reduction with a formulation intended to limit post-injection swelling and discomfort. It ships ready-to-use for professional administration.
howItWorks: Lecithin (phosphatidylcholine) acts on adipocyte membranes to emulsify and break down fat cells, while bromelain, a pineapple-derived enzyme, supports lipolysis and helps reduce edema. Liberated lipids are cleared through the lymphatic system over the following weeks. This enzyme/phospholipid mechanism differs from deoxycholic-acid detergent solutions.
usageNotes: Inject subcutaneously into the mid-fat plane in a grid pattern with conservative per-point volumes, staging sessions about 3-4 weeks apart. Product is supplied ready-to-use (no mixing). Expect swelling and tenderness in the days after treatment, and respect body-region depth and anatomy.
features: Enzyme action intended to reduce swelling
benefits: Alternative mechanism for patients or clinicians preferring non-deoxycholate options
Ready-to-use format streamlines chairside workflow
Non-surgical approach to localized body fat
Established Korean manufacturer aids sourcing confidence
Pairs with Slim Point Face for a full-range offering

description: Kabelline is a South Korean injectable lipolysis solution built on synthetic deoxycholic acid, marketed for submental and other localized fat reduction. It belongs to the deoxycholic-acid detergent class of fat-dissolving injectables and is supplied for professional use, typically in multi-vial boxes. Supplier listings attribute manufacture to Korean firms (variously Neogenesis and Wellspharmtech), so a single verified maker is not asserted here.
howItWorks: Deoxycholic acid, a bile-acid detergent, disrupts adipocyte cell membranes and causes adipocytolysis at the injection site. The liberated lipids and cellular debris are cleared by macrophages and the lymphatic system and metabolized over several weeks. The resulting local inflammatory response drives the expected swelling over the first 3-7 days.
composition: Synthetic deoxycholic acid (with plant-extract adjuncts per supplier listings)
usageNotes: Inject subcutaneously into the mid-fat plane using a grid pattern (points spaced roughly 1 cm), keeping per-point volumes conservative (around 0.2 mL), and stage sessions about 3-4 weeks apart. Deoxycholic acid is a potent detergent: avoid superficial injection to reduce dermal/skin-necrosis risk, and inject with precision away from the marginal mandibular nerve when treating the submental area. Expect swelling for 3-7 days.
features: Same active class as established deoxycholic-acid injectables
benefits: Non-surgical option for double chin and small fat pockets
Recognizable brand supports patient confidence
Deoxycholic-acid mechanism familiar to practitioners
Staged protocol suits course-based pricing
